info.name: Search for issues. Requires the 'Browse' permission on the specified project(s).

params.name: additionalFields
params.description: Comma-separated list of the optional fields to be returned in response. Action plans are dropped in 5.5, it is not returned in the response.

params.name: assigned
params.description: To retrieve assigned or unassigned issues

params.name: assignees
params.description: Comma-separated list of assignee logins. The value '__me__' can be used as a placeholder for user who performs the request

params.name: author
params.description: SCM accounts. To set several values, the parameter must be called once for each value.

params.name: cleanCodeAttributeCategories
params.description: Comma-separated list of clean code attribute categories.

params.name: complianceStandards
params.description: Set of compliance standards to filter on. Categories within a standard are comma-separated and behave as an 'or'. Multiple standards are separated by an ampersand and behave as an 'and'.

params.name: componentKeys
params.description: Comma-separated list of component keys. Retrieve issues associated to a specific list of components (and all its descendants). A component can be a project, directory or file.

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: To retrieve issues created after the given date (inclusive). Either a date (server timezone) or datetime can be provided. If this parameter is set, createdSince must not be set

params.name: createdAt
params.description: Datetime to retrieve issues created during a specific analysis

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: To retrieve issues created before the given date (inclusive). Either a date (server timezone) or datetime can be provided.

params.name: createdInLast
params.description: To retrieve issues created during a time span before the current time (exclusive). Accepted units are 'y' for year, 'm' for month, 'w' for week and 'd' for day. If this parameter is set, createdAfter must not be set

params.name: cwe
params.description: Comma-separated list of CWE identifiers. Use 'unknown' to select issues not associated to any CWE.

params.name: facetMode
params.description: Choose the returned value for facet items, either count of issues or sum of remediation effort.

params.name: facets
params.description: Comma-separated list of the facets to be computed. No facet is computed by default.

params.name: languages
params.description: Comma-separated list of languages. Available since 4.4

params.name: onComponentOnly
params.description: Return only issues at a component's level, not on its descendants (modules, directories, files, etc). This parameter is only considered when componentKeys or componentUuids is set.

params.name: owaspMobileTop10-2024
params.description: Comma-separated list of OWASP Mobile Top 10 - 2024 lowercase categories.

params.name: owaspTop10
params.description: Comma-separated list of OWASP Top 10 lowercase categories.

params.name: owaspTop10-2021
params.description: Comma-separated list of OWASP Top 10 - 2021 lowercase categories.

params.name: ps
params.description: Page size. Must be greater than 0 and less or equal than 500

params.name: resolved
params.description: To match resolved or unresolved issues

params.name: rules
params.description: Comma-separated list of coding rule keys. Format is <repository>:<rule>

params.name: sinceLeakPeriod
params.description: To retrieve issues created since the leak period. If this parameter is set to a truthy value, createdAfter must not be set and one component id or key must be provided.

params.name: sonarsourceSecurity
params.description: Comma-separated list of SonarSource security categories. Use 'others' to select issues not associated with any category
